subject: Laptop order follow-up
text:
Hi,
I’m circling back on the external drive order because procurement marked it as pending, and I need the tracking number before my afternoon call. I thought we agreed to order the smaller capacity, since our old drives are fine and the bigger model would push us past the budget line. You mentioned the larger one might last longer, and that may be true, but I still worry about the extra cost and the delayed shipping date.

Can you check whether the order was actually submitted? If it went through, please forward the vendor confirmation. If it didn’t, we should pause before Friday, get one more quote, and decide together. I’m not trying to stall the purchase; I just want us to be careful with the team’s leftover budget.

I know we both want a fast fix, especially after yesterday’s backup issue. Still, I’m uneasy about approving something without comparing the return date against the maintenance schedule. The larger drives are nice, but if they arrive after the lab move, the extra time could become wasted money. We don’t need perfection, only a sensible balance.

If you already placed it, I won’t argue. I just need to see the receipt and know when it arrives. If not, give me ten minutes today so we can settle it before I leave. I can take notes, and you can send me anything procurement requested.

Thanks,
R
